title: Tapestry project configuration
description: Project profile read by Tapestry skills, agents and hooks. Edit with /tapestry-setup or by hand.

description.description: One paragraph: what the project is and who it is for.

baseBranch.description: Branch that PRs target and worktrees branch from.

repo.description: OWNER/REPO on GitHub. Leave empty to detect from origin.

commands.description: Shell commands agents run to prove work. Empty string = not available; agents skip it and say so.

format.description: Formatter run by the post-edit hook. Should accept a file path as the last argument.

maxReviewRounds.description: Review -> fix -> re-review cycles per PR before a human is asked.

humanMergesPRs.description: true = orchestrator stops at 'approved'; a human merges. false = orchestrator merges approved PRs in wave order.

skipPipelineBelowLines.description: Heuristic: if the whole change is under this many lines, suggest doing it directly instead of running the pipeline.

autoApplyFixes.description: Reviewer commits fixes to the PR branch. false = reviewer only posts patches as comments.

models.description: Model alias per role: inherit | haiku | sonnet | opus | fable | full model id.
